scope: Source semantics, screening proof and small independent fixtures approved for r1 only. This is not approval of actual numerical outputs; each fresh outcome diagnosis must subsequently pass unchanged gates.
proofReview: For each positive/negative tail, monotonic rounded addition can differ from threshold subtraction only inside the interval obtained by first moving the cutoff toward each exterior binary64 neighbor, subtracting a, then rounding that result outward. Both original cutoffs are enclosed using their min/max. This covers cancellation a approximately cutoff, b approximately zero, unlike widening only the already subtracted bound.

Outside both returned intervals all four tail decisions agree, so all signed differences are zero there. Inside their union each pair is evaluated once using exact original upper-plus-lower integer comparison sums. Multiplicity products and signed sums remain Python arbitrary-size integers.

The source enforces finite score magnitudes and cutoffs below 1e6 and strictly positive cutoffs, excluding overflow or cutoff-zero claims. Inclusive tails, signed zero, minimum subnormal cutoffs and overlapping subtraction tails are explicitly exercised.

The current completed independent own-addition count anchors all four reconstructions. Scalar support and labeled factorial masses are recreated with both frozen helpers and required identical before screening. Original primary and independent observed cutoffs and reported p/q values remain separate and unchanged.

Runtime PASS additionally requires both subtraction and direct-addition counts at the primary observed cutoff to equal the unchanged primary integer. A genuine common-threshold predicate disagreement cannot be silently reclassified as an observed-statistic ULP shift.
followUpRequired: Owner may execute the bounded fresh r1 diagnosis only after root GO. Root must inspect actual outcome receipts and use ordinary numerical validation and fresh publication chain; no model or social result is attested by this source gate.
